title: COLD STORAGE GETS ITS FLOOR
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it (item 12, richer ground), gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. The open ground of COLD STORAGE was one flat colour with grime, so the Packing Floor, Chill Row and the Scrap Line all looked like the same car park. The floor now carries what a working cold store leaves behind: painted forklift lanes with stop bars and arrows down the open racking of the Packing Floor, frost around the Chill Row units and spreading from the Blast Freezer, oil stains and tyre tracks across the Scrap Line, and drain grates on the open ground. It is painted once into the floor, so it costs nothing to draw, and it is the same every raid. Nothing about play changes.
now: COLD STORAGE now has a dressed floor: forklift lanes, frost, oil and tyre tracks, and drains.
